name: async_hooks createHook reports resources timers and promises
source: import { createHook, AsyncResource, executionAsyncId, triggerAsyncId } from 'node:async_hooks'; function main(): void { const types = new Map<number, string>(); const log: string[] = []; const hook = createHook({ init(id: number, type: string, trigger: number) { if (type === 'MyRes' || type === 'Timeout' || type === 'PROMISE') { types.set(id, type); if (type !== 'PROMISE') log.push('init:' + type); } }, before(id: number) { const t = types.get(id); if (t && t !== 'PROMISE') log.push('before:' + t); }, after(id: number) { const t = types.get(id); if (t && t !== 'PROMISE') log.push('after:' + t); }, destroy(id: number) { const t = types.get(id); if (t && t !== 'PROMISE') log.push('destroy:' + t); }, promiseResolve(id: number) { if (types.get(id) === 'PROMISE') log.push('resolve:PROMISE'); } }).enable(); const resource = new AsyncResource('MyRes'); resource.runInAsyncScope(() => { log.push('scope ' + (executionAsyncId() === resource.asyncId()) + ' ' + (triggerAsyncId() === resource.triggerAsyncId())); }); setTimeout(() => { log.push('timeout'); resource.emitDestroy(); }, 10); setTimeout(() => { hook.disable(); console.log(log.filter((entry) => !entry.endsWith('PROMISE')).join(',')); }, 40); }
